diff --git a/tests/typing/typing_edit.py b/tests/typing/typing_edit.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..848ba94cbe144be91f50252e77dacedb9755f964
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/typing/typing_edit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from typing_extensions import assert_type
+
+import click
+
+# ``filename`` accepts a path or an iterable of paths.
+assert_type(click.edit(filename="f.txt"), None)
+assert_type(click.edit(filename=Path("f.txt")), None)
+assert_type(click.edit(filename=["f.txt", Path("g.txt")]), None)
